coordinateSystem.usage: Multiply x by target width and y by target height.

geometry.notes: Simplified manual traces of solid terrain in the reference screenshots, not pixel-perfect outlines. Decorative vines, cats, UI, ball trails and moving shredders are excluded. Polygons may be concave; decompose before creating convex physics fixtures. Adjacent terrain pieces may overlap.

placeholderNotes: Empty arrays reserve object categories; positions and behavior have not been authored.
